title: Printing a receipt is never tested
what: No test opens the print view of a receipt. Nothing checks that only the receipt sheet prints, that the buttons and menu stay off the paper, or that a second print keeps the same number.
expected: A test prints a receipt and checks the paper shows only the receipt, with the same number each time.
fix_line: Add one print-view check to the receipt test

title: Ready-made challenge cards: saving, failures and blocked states are never seen in a test
what: The challenge test turns cards on and off on the happy path only. No test shows the Saving button with the others greyed, a failed save, the 'not switched on yet' card, the 60-day blocked line, the offline button, a turned-off card after a refresh, or a second run starting from zero.
expected: A test drives each of these states and checks the words and that nothing is saved.
fix_line: Add screen checks for the failure and blocked states

title: The 'Joined online' card is never tested as the front desk, and its error lines never at all
what: Every Joined online test signs in as the owner. The desk is the one who usually makes these people members, yet no test does it as the desk, checks the receipt names the desk person, or shows the lines for someone else approving, could not approve, could not check the payment, or a name that could not be saved.
expected: A test signs in as front desk staff, approves and makes a member, and drives each error line.
fix_line: Add a desk run of the Joined online card with its error lines

title: The Android 'Install the admin app' button is never tested, and no test shows the card to staff
what: Every install-card test runs with no install offer from the browser, so the card only ever shows 'Show me how'. The Install button, Chrome's install sheet and the card leaving after install are never checked, and no test signs in as staff to see the card.
expected: A test fakes the browser's install offer, taps Install, and checks the card goes; one run as staff.
fix_line: Fake the install offer in the install-card test

title: Quick buttons: the desk view, the six-button limit and an empty list are never seen on screen
what: The only screen test is the owner adding one button. Nothing signs in as the desk to check hidden buttons and no Change link, and nothing shows the greyed rows at six, the empty list, the sheet sentence or the Expenses page opening.
expected: A test checks the desk's buttons and the sheet's limits on screen.
fix_line: Add a desk run and a six-button run to the quick buttons test

title: Most lines under settings are checked only as text in the code, not on screen
what: The setting-lines test reads the sentences and searches the screen code for their names. Only three lines are ever seen on screen. The branch wording, the web-page wording, the UPI line and the tick-box lines are never seen under their setting.
expected: A screen test opens each settings tab and checks the line under each setting, in a branch too.
fix_line: Add one screen walk through the settings tabs

title: Free days for a friend: refusals, failed save and the desk's view are never seen on screen
what: The friend test covers the happy path. The 'not on your member list' and 'no plan running' sentences, the 'No free days' toast, a failed save, the desk opening a referred enquiry, and the reward line on the receipt are never seen on screen.
expected: A test drives each refusal and the desk view on screen.
fix_line: Add the refusal cases to the friend test

title: The paid-online journey expects a Make member button that the card does not show
what: The journey says a paid-online row shows both Approve and Make member. The code shows only Approve, and the test checks Make member is absent. The journey line is wrong, so a later reader may report a bug that is not there.
expected: The journey says the paid row shows Approve only.
fix_line: Correct the journey line to Approve only
